validatorWarnings: 23 paragraph-length warnings across the edition: body paragraphs over 80 words (worst 108 in 2026-11-03-local-001, 105 in local-002, 104 in tech-001). Non-blocking; the edition published Valid.
All warnings are of the form 'articles[N].body (id) paragraph N is X words — over 80, which reads as a wall of text on a phone. Aim for 30–80'.
workarounds: national: only three stories shipped. A fourth and fifth angle on the Urda crash existed (victim identification, Moroccan industry) but every candidate needed a source URL already cited by another article in the same section, which the duplicate-source rule flags. Dropped rather than duplicated.

local-002 (Sarria cultural centre) is sourced from three pages on elprogreso.es because no second outlet has covered the story; the two older pieces carry the 2010/2020/Cine Cissa history and the TSXG setback.

local-001 (Monforte school cleaners) is the one story this run could not confirm on a second outlet's live page: La Voz de Galicia 403s to non-browser clients, so its €195,000/year contract figure is cited from the search index, not from a fetch.

Northern Ireland and part of tech are single-outlet stories under the hood: newsletter.co.uk and derryjournal.com both 403 to scripted requests and were verified only by HTTP status, not by reading content. The Lockhart facts come from the BBC article.
Al Jazeera article and live-blog URLs returned 404 (not 403) when fetched, so Al Jazeera was excluded from global sourcing even though its RSS listed the midterms and Iran live coverage.
tech-005 (NYT v Brave) facts come from TechCrunch plus The Verge and Search Engine Journal headlines; the Verge and SEJ pages were status-checked only.
notes: 19 articles, all six sections present, 19/19 photos. Lead is local (Monforte school cleaners unpaid for two months). National was reshaped late: rather than a fourth day of pure Urda-collision coverage, it leads on the Diputación Permanente arithmetic before Puente's appearance, then the Iryo control-centre transcript and the 36-year low in infrastructure investment. Global leads on the US strikes on Qeshm Island hours before the midterms. AI carries two Anthropic S-1A stories on deliberately different axes (a capability warning in the risk factors; $895bn of spending commitments and the case for blocking the listing) with disjoint source sets — the one borderline call of the run.
